name: Dr. Arvind Kumar
subject: Mathematics
bio: Dr. Kumar has a passion for breaking down complex calculus and algebra concepts into easy-to-understand logical steps. He has helped hundreds of students clear competitive exams like JEE.

name: Prof. Priya Sharma
subject: Physics
bio: Prof. Sharma specializes in making Physics intuitive through real-world examples. Her interactive teaching methods make learning mechanics and electromagnetism fun and engaging.
degree: M.Sc. in Applied Physics, IISc Bangalore

name: Rajesh Singh
subject: Chemistry
bio: An expert in Organic Chemistry, Rajesh believes in visual learning. His sessions are filled with 3D molecular modeling and practical insights into chemical reactions.

name: Dr. Sunita Verma
subject: Biology
bio: Dr. Verma is a dedicated botanist and zoologist. Her deep knowledge of human anatomy and plant physiology has helped many aspiring medical students achieve their goals.

name: Amit Patel
subject: Computer Science
bio: Amit is a former software engineer who transitioned to teaching. He focuses on core programming logic, algorithms, and full-stack development to make students industry-ready.
degree: B.Tech in Computer Science, NIT Trichy

name: Meena Iyer
subject: English
bio: Meena brings literature to life. From Shakespearean dramas to modern Indian writing, her classes focus on critical thinking, vocabulary building, and advanced grammar.

name: Anil Desai
subject: History
bio: Anil believes history is not just about dates, but about stories. He specializes in Modern Indian History and World History, providing a captivating narrative approach.

name: Kavita Reddy
subject: Economics
bio: Kavita simplifies complex economic theories. Her macro and microeconomics classes are filled with case studies from the Indian and global economy.

name: Suresh Menon
subject: Geography
bio: Suresh makes learning geography a global tour. His expertise lies in physical geography and environmental science, utilizing digital mapping tools for better understanding.
degree: M.Sc. in Geography, University of Madras

name: Neha Gupta
subject: Accountancy
bio: A certified Chartered Accountant, Neha teaches Accountancy with a practical edge. She ensures students master the fundamentals of financial statements and corporate accounting.
